description: This file contains a function that sets the MAC addresses of Ethernet interfaces during the pre-initialization phase based on the specific board model. It relies on external functions to retrieve MAC addresses and applies different logic depending on the board type.

methods.name: preinit_set_mac_address
methods.description: Sets the MAC addresses for network interfaces based on the board type, using various external functions to fetch the MAC addresses from different sources.

calls: ip link set dev eth0 address
ip link set dev eth1 address
